entries.statement: Branch protection, rulesets, required checks, and reviewer identity cannot be proven from repository files alone; only GitHub-side evidence counts.
entries.mitigation: GAP-0001 requires gh api evidence before any enforcement claim; autoChildMerge stays disabled.

entries.statement: Expo, Firebase, Maps, push, and native module behavior on real devices is invisible to static checks and to the Docker runtime profile.
entries.mitigation: The native proof dimension activates in wave P1-C; until then native claims resolve to NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

entries.statement: Payment, SMS, and map providers can change behavior outside any repository evidence; simulators only approximate them.
entries.mitigation: Resilience dimension (provider 500, timeout, malformed response) activates in wave P1-C; provider incidents route to BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

entries.statement: Green tests do not prove assertion strength; surviving mutants are invisible until mutation testing activates.
entries.mitigation: Mutation dimension activates in wave P1-B for auth, isolation, orders, payments, refunds, settlements, state transitions, permissions.
